warnings: First of three pile-cap detail sheets (S-10/S-11/S-12, หน้า37/38/39) covering F2, F5, F6, F9, F10, F12 — the pile-footing alternate of the foundation (S-03/หน้า30). Only one system is built; see S-02/หน้า29's 'เลือกใช้ชนิดใดชนิดหนึ่งเท่านั้น' warning. F2 is used at A1/A2 and F5 at E1/E3/B3.

Each detail is drawn as a section plus a plan of the cap. The plan dimension chain gives pile centres, not member edges: F2 reads 0.20|0.225|0.225|0.20 = 0.85 across (pile, column centre, pile) and 0.20|0.20 = 0.40 deep; F5 reads 0.20|0.35|0.35|0.20 = 1.10 both ways. Cap outline dimensions recorded as width_mm/depth_mm are those chain totals.

Notes common to every pile cap on S-10/S-11/S-12 and recorded once per element: '1ø12มม.ยาว 1.00 ม.' is a dowel from each pile head into the cap; 'กรอกคอนกรีตลึก 0.50 ม.' means the hollow pile head is filled with concrete 0.50m deep; the pile head embeds 0.05m into the cap; bedding is 0.10m คอนกรีต 1:3:5 over 0.05m ทรายราดน้ำอัดแน่น (note the spread footings on S-08/S-09 use 0.10 sand instead of 0.05); cap bottom sits 1.00m below ระดับดินเดิม ±0.00.
Pile section/length is NOT given on these sheets — only the count per cap. The pile type and depth would come from a soil-boring/pile sheet not reached in this extraction.
Bar-type convention: ø9มม and smaller recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø'.
'1ø9มม.รัดรอบ' (one Ø9 bound around the cap perimeter at mid-depth) is on both details and is recorded under additional_bars, not as part of the main mat.
